metadata.description: Agent skills for building and managing with WSO2 products

plugins.name: api-platform
plugins.description: Skills for the WSO2 API Platform — design, assess, and fix OpenAPI specs for AI agent readiness, security, and design quality; then set up, publish, and manage APIs through the WSO2 API Gateway using the ap CLI.

plugins.name: agent-manager
plugins.description: Skill for driving the WSO2 agent-manager lifecycle through the amctl CLI — install, log in, create/deploy agents, watch builds, fetch logs and metrics, and triage runtime issues.

plugins.name: integrator
plugins.description: Skills for WSO2 Integrator — build integrations, automations, and services with WSO2 Integrator conventions. Installs the Ballerina plugin alongside for writing, running, and testing the code.

plugins.name: ballerina
plugins.description: Write, build, run, and test Ballerina integrations and services, discover connectors from Ballerina Central, and get language-server code intelligence for .bal files. Installed automatically with integrator.

plugins.name: healthcare
plugins.description: WSO2 Healthcare skills: write services and integrations in Ballerina for healthcare applications, including HL7v2 and FHIR support.
